testcase.name: TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-low" for low priority todos
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-high" for high priority todos
TodoItemComponent getPriorityClass should return "priority-medium" for medium priority todos
TodoItemComponent should apply the "completed" class when the todo is completed
TodoItemComponent should call onToggle when the checkbox state changes
TodoItemComponent should create
TodoItemComponent should call onDelete when the delete button is clicked
TodoItemComponent should display the todo text
TodoItemComponent should reflect the todo completion status in the checkbox
App should create the app
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent logic importantTodos computed signal should be empty if there are no high-priority, incomplete todos
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent logic importantTodos computed signal should contain only high-priority, incomplete todos
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent logic importantTodos computed signal should update automatically when the source signal changes
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent logic filterAndProcessTodos should filter by completion status
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent logic filterAndProcessTodos should return all todos when no filters are applied
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent logic filterAndProcessTodos should filter by both priority and completion status
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent logic filterAndProcessTodos should filter by priority
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent template rendering should display the list of important todos when they exist
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent template rendering should display the "no important items" message when importantTodos is empty
ImportantTodoSummaryComponent should create
GodService Todo List Responsibility getTodos should return a writable signal with initial todos
GodService Todo List Responsibility addTodo should add a new todo to the signal
GodService Todo List Responsibility deleteTodo should not change the list if id does not exist
GodService Todo List Responsibility toggleTodo should flip the isCompleted status of an existing todo
GodService Todo List Responsibility toggleTodo should not change the list if id does not exist
GodService Todo List Responsibility deleteTodo should remove an existing todo
GodService Other Responsibilities getUsers should return a list of users and log the action
GodService Other Responsibilities addUser should log the action
GodService Other Responsibilities addProduct should log the action
GodService Other Responsibilities getProducts should return a list of products and log the action
GodService Other Responsibilities getConfig should return a config value string and log the action
GodService Other Responsibilities log should call console.log with a formatted message
GodService Other Responsibilities updateConfig should log the action
GodService should be created
